experiment.topic: Hourly trend persistence in BTC-USD across market regimes
experiment.hypothesis: A 20-hour trend in BTC-USD persists across market regimes defined by 20-hour standard deviation, with a directional accuracy of at least 70% in high-volatility regimes.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: For a 20-hour lookback trend rule in BTC-USD, if the trend direction (up/down) reverses within the next 1 hour, and this reversal occurs in a regime defined by a 20-hour standard deviation of price movement exceeding 3% volatility, then the trend persistence hypothesis is falsified.
